# Jayanth Kappagantula

> Portfolio of Jayanth Kappagantula, a product manager who starts with the people using the product: engineer by training, then enterprise systems (Pega, Salesforce), most recently a Technical Product Manager co-op at Stage Zero Health, an early cancer detection startup. Based in Atlanta, GA; open to full-time product roles anywhere in the US.

The site is a single-page app; this file and the Markdown version below are plain text for AI tools and search.

## Text version

- [About Jayanth (Markdown)](https://thisisjayk.github.io/Portfolio/jayanth-kappagantula.md): experience, education, certifications, skills and contact, in plain text.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://thisisjayk.github.io/Portfolio/resume.pdf): the one-page résumé.
